evidence: The artisans who inhabit this sacred space have honed their craft over generations, imbuing each piece with a deep sense of tradition and cultural significance. As one steps into the workshop, the steady clinking rhythm of chisels and small hammers tapping rhythmically on the copper and bronze surface is like a symphony, captivating the senses and transporting visitors to a bygone era.

The copper and bronze blocks, shaped like dragons and phoenixes, lie silently on rustic wooden stands, their lustrous sheen contrasting starkly with the gleaming steel light of the sharp chisels. The exclusive identifying feature of this craft is the extremely thin, tightly coiled copper swarf that flies out after each decisive, clinking hammer blow, a testament to the artisans' unwavering attention to detail.
